name: bakul
description: Pasar daring untuk pedagang kecil Indonesia. Logika transaksi asli, uang simulasi.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @bakul/shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @bakul/api" "npm run dev --workspace @bakul/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @bakul/shared && npm run build --workspace @bakul/api && npm run build --workspace @bakul/web
